decision_summary: Approve QIF v0.3.1 release as a docs-only patch release for pre-implementation and done-before quality gating.
rationale: The release packages accepted guidance plus the final feedback additions: evidence independence, done-before Guardian questions, rubric-based visual verification, and Living QIF Ledger. It preserves QIF standalone use and does not claim runtime schema or semantic-truth verification.
recommendation: Run final verification, commit, tag v0.3.1, push main and tag, and create GitHub Release v0.3.1 from RELEASE-NOTES-v0.3.1.md.
target_audience: QIF maintainers, human reviewers, and AI agents applying QIF before implementation
expected_user_reaction: They can treat QIF as a completion gate instead of only a post-hoc record while understanding that v0.3.1 is documentation-only.
artifact_change_recommendations: Implement executable pre-implementation review records and verifier rules in a later slice.
organization_change_recommendations: Use done-before Guardian questions and evidence independence before closing high-severity work.
